content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026 Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), a Public Sector Undertaking. Which posts? Artisan Grade IV in seven trades: Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic and Foundryman. How many vacancies? 660 (tentative, as per the notification). Who can apply? Candidates with Class X, plus National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI), plus National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the respective trade, with the minimum marks stated below. Application start date and last date: Not specified in the provided notification. Application mode: Not specified in the provided notification. The notification says instructions on how to apply will be hosted on the BHEL Careers website by 19 October 2026. Job location: BHEL manufacturing units at Ranipet, Visakhapatnam, Bengaluru, Haridwar, Hyderabad, Bhopal, Jhansi and Tiruchirappalli.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BHEL has notified a total of 660 Artisan Grade IV vacancies for the year 2027 requirement. The notification states that the manpower requirement is tentative and the actual requirement may vary based on further assessment. Category-wise reservation will be as per government guidelines. As per BHEL policy, the Artisan Grade IV vacancies are partially earmarked to be filled through dependents of deceased employees of BHEL on compassionate grounds. The notification says all relevant details on how and who can apply under this category are given in the "Compassionate Consideration" link on careers.bhel.in . If these vacancies are not filled due to non-availability of qualified candidates, they may be filled through open selection.

rows.location_as_per_notification: Tiruchirappalli (state not mentioned in the notification)

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible for BHEL Artisan Grade IV recruitment, candidates must meet the educational qualification and age limit given below. Candidates must also note the unit choice rule in the notification: a candidate can apply against vacancies of only one unit, and must choose the Manufacturing Unit of preference carefully, against the vacancies available in the respective trades.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Qualification
content_sections.text: The required qualification is Class X plus National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI) plus National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the respective trade. Candidates need not less than 60% marks (General and OBC) or 55% marks (SC and ST) in both NTC/ITI and NAC. The notification does not specify EWS or PwD minimum marks separately. It lists the marks requirement only for Gen and OBC candidates and for SC and ST candidates.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is calculated as on 1 October 2026. The notification does not specify a minimum age limit. PwD and Ex-Serviceman age relaxation will be as per Government rules. Up to 07 years of age relaxation is available on the basis of relevant work experience in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Reservation and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The notification states that the details of reservation and relaxation accorded to UR, EWS, SC, ST, OBC (NCL), PwD and Ex-Servicemen candidates will be provided on the BHEL Careers Portal on 19 October 2026. Category-wise reservation will be as per government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification states that details of the Selection Process and instructions on how to apply will be hosted on the BHEL Careers website by 19 October 2026. It also mentions that the Computer Based Test (CBT) for all the above vacancies will be held on the same day, i.e. in December (Tentative). Any further selection stages are not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification does not give the application steps or the application mode. It says that instructions on how to apply will be hosted on the BHEL Careers website by 19 October 2026. Candidates should keep the following points from the notification in mind and check https://careers.bhel.in for the full process. Visit the BHEL Careers website at careers.bhel.in. Read the application instructions and selection process details once they are hosted (by 19 October 2026, as per the notification). Choose the Manufacturing Unit of your preference carefully, as one candidate can apply against vacancies of one unit only. Apply in the trade in which you hold the NTC/ITI and NAC.

faq.question: Q1. What is BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited under Advertisement Number 01/2026 to fill 660 Artisan vacancies across various units.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 660 vacancies are available for posts including Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, and Foundryman.

faq.question: Q3. When did the BHEL Artisan application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process started on 19th October, 2026 on the official BHEL Careers portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for BHEL Artisan posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Class X plus National Trade Certificate (NTC / ITI) plus National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the respective trade with not less than 60% marks for Gen and OBC candidates and 55% marks for SC and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for General and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for General and EWS candidates is 27 years as on 1st October, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the BHEL Artisan selection process?
faq.answer: The notification mentions a Computer Based Test (CBT) in December (Tentative), held on the same day for all vacancies. Details of the Selection Process will be hosted on the BHEL Careers website by 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not state the application steps. Instructions on how to apply will be hosted on the BHEL Careers website (careers.bhel.in) by 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one BHEL unit?
faq.answer: No. The notification states that one candidate can apply against vacancies of one unit only.
